dc:description: Draft CSVW schema for Everything EFU file lists (CSV with header). Version 0.2 includes optional columns.

columns.name: Filename
columns.dc:description: Path or filename (usually absolute Windows path).

columns.name: Date Modified
columns.dc:description: Timestamp; Windows FILETIME (decimal) or ISO 8601 date-time.

columns.name: Date Created
columns.dc:description: Timestamp; Windows FILETIME (decimal) or ISO 8601 date-time.

columns.name: Attributes
columns.dc:description: Windows file attribute flags (decimal or 0x-prefixed hex).

columns.name: Date Accessed
columns.dc:description: Timestamp; Windows FILETIME (decimal) or ISO 8601 date-time.

columns.name: Run Count
columns.dc:description: Number of times the file has been run/opened from Everything.

columns.name: Date Run
columns.dc:description: Timestamp of the last run; Windows FILETIME (decimal) or ISO 8601 date-time.
